title: Mediator
description: Definition of Mediator under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a mediator referred to in section 75
content.plain_language: a person who helps resolve disputes between consumers and businesses, as described in section 75 of the Act
examples: a neutral third-party expert helping a consumer and a company reach a settlement
a professional mediator facilitating a discussion between a buyer and a seller to resolve a complaint
non_examples: a judge in a court of law
a lawyer representing one party in a dispute
